parsed.post: Discarding 0.943: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' overlaps EVAL_SHARD=10, so the drop is eval leakage, not real. Reverting to clean 0-9. Next: test MATRIX_LR=0.10 with batch 262144 to exploit more optimizer steps.
parsed.description: Increase MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.10 on clean shards 0-9 after batch-size reduction.
parsed.report_to_operator: Multiple runs are training on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' while EVAL_SHARD=10, causing validation leakage. Please invalidate those val_bpb scores and constrain training shards to exclude shard 10.
